items.followUp: What are the lower and upper fixed points used to graduate a Celsius thermometer?

rubric.why: The lower fixed point is the temperature of melting ice, called the ice point, at standard atmospheric pressure.
rubric.description: Identifies the lower fixed point as the melting-ice temperature.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the lower fixed point with melting ice, the ice point, or 0°C.

rubric.why: The upper fixed point is the temperature of steam above boiling water, called the steam point, at standard atmospheric pressure.
rubric.description: Identifies the upper fixed point as the steam-point temperature.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the upper fixed point with steam above boiling water, the steam point, or 100°C.

modelAnswer: The lower fixed point is the temperature of melting ice, called the ice point, at standard atmospheric pressure (0°C).
The upper fixed point is the temperature of steam above boiling water, called the steam point, at standard atmospheric pressure (100°C).
